title: Constraint: Last Four Values Unique
constraints: Across **successive calls** of `randomize()` on the same object, no value may repeat within any 4 consecutive results (each result differs from the previous three).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Constraints can refer to **non-random** class members: keep a history queue.
Update the history in `post_randomize()`, which runs after every successful randomization.
`foreach (prev[i]) val != prev[i];` keeps working as the queue grows from 0 to 3 entries.
